boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented Salve activities with free entry or registration, spanning outdoor recreation, conversation, volunteering, learning, and campus events.

cards.entity_name: FREE Surf Lesson with Rhody Surf
cards.title: Try the free surf lesson
cards.subtitle: Easton's Beach · Newport
cards.notes: Register during the listed window, then meet RecSports at Easton's Beach for a beginner lesson; boards are provided and wetsuits are available.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, beginner-focused beach activity for eligible new surfers.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve RecSports lists this Easton's Beach lesson as free, with surfboards provided and wetsuits available; it is for new surfers comfortable in the water.
cards.source_title: FREE Surf Lesson with Rhody Surf
cards.access_notes: Registration is limited to new surfers and the organizer specifies a registration window; participants must be comfortable in the water.

cards.title: Volunteer at the community meal handout
cards.subtitle: Mercy Commons Kitchen to St. Paul's Church · Newport
cards.notes: RSVP for the Salve service shift, meet at Mercy Commons Kitchen, and help transport and hand out prepared meals at St. Paul's Church.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, organized service activity that works alongside other Salve volunteers.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve's Center for Community Engagement and Service lists the RSVP option as free and directs volunteers to meet at Mercy Commons before the meal handout.
cards.access_notes: The listing limits registration to one ticket per person and says volunteers should dress for outdoor weather.

cards.title: Join the Compass North retreat
cards.subtitle: Salve Regina University · Newport
cards.notes: Eligible first-year student athletes can reserve the listed retreat and spend the day in guided reflection and connection with peers.
cards.short_summary: A free, daylong Salve Compass gathering for the specified first-year athletic teams.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve Compass lists its Student Athletes retreat as free and says lunch and a snack are provided.
cards.access_notes: Reserved for the student-athlete groups named in the event listing; RSVP availability and timing are listed on the page.

cards.title: Meet incoming classmates at Summer Business Day
cards.subtitle: DiStefano Lecture Hall · 44 and 56 Lawrence Ave., Newport
cards.notes: Newly admitted students and families can attend the optional day to meet campus offices, hear presentations, and connect with future classmates.
cards.short_summary: A free orientation-style day for admitted students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve lists Summer Business Day as a free event and describes it as a day for newly admitted students and families to visit campus and meet with offices.
cards.access_notes: Designed for newly admitted students and families; the official listing calls the event optional and provides the event schedule.

cards.entity_name: Earth Week Market and Field Day 2026
cards.title: Browse Earth Week Field Day
cards.subtitle: Gerety Hall Lawn · 51 Lawrence Ave., Newport
cards.notes: Drop by the Gerety lawn to view student and faculty sustainability work, visit club tables, and make a sea-glass project or plant pot.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor campus event combining environmental projects, student groups, and hands-on activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve lists the Earth Week Market and Field Day at Gerety Hall Lawn as a free event and describes research displays, club tables, planting, and sea-glass creation.
cards.source_title: Earth Week Market and Field Day 2026
cards.access_notes: The event listing names Gerety Hall Lawn and identifies it as open to Salve audiences and the general public.

cards.entity_name: Arbor Day Tree Planting, Earth Champion Awards, and Arboretum Tour
cards.title: Take the Arboretum Tour
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library Front Lawn · 25 Ochre Point Ave., Newport
cards.notes: Meet near the Munroe Building for the tree planting and awards, then join the Salve Tree Hawks' guided arboretum tour.
cards.short_summary: A free Salve nature walk paired with a campus tree-planting gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve lists this Arbor Day gathering as a free event and states that an Arboretum Tour follows the planting and awards, with all welcome.
cards.source_title: Earth Week: Arbor Day Tree Planting, Earth Champion Awards, and Arboretum Tour
cards.access_notes: Meet at the McKillop Library front lawn near the Munroe Building; the listing states that all are welcome.

cards.title: Attend a Newport MFA reading
cards.subtitle: Young Building · 518 Bellevue Ave., Newport
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the Young Building for a guest reading and craft talk presented through Salve's Newport MFA summer workshop.
cards.short_summary: A free public literary event in Salve's Newport MFA residency series.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve identifies the Newport MFA reading as a free event and says the residency's guest readings and craft talks are free and open to the Salve community and general public.
cards.access_notes: The official listing says the event is open to both the Salve community and the general public.

cards.entity_name: Newport MFA Guest Reading, Debra Curtis
cards.title: Hear a guest reading at Ochre Court
cards.subtitle: Ochre Court · 16 Ochre Point Ave., Newport
cards.notes: Plan an afternoon at Ochre Court for a Newport MFA guest reading and craft talk, part of Salve's summer writing workshop.
cards.short_summary: A free public reading in a named Salve campus landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve lists the Debra Curtis Newport MFA guest reading at Ochre Court as free and states that the residency's readings and craft talks are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Newport MFA Guest Reading, Debra Curtis
cards.access_notes: The listing states that the event is open to the Salve community and the general public.

cards.title: Take Mental Health First Aid training
cards.subtitle: Antone Academic Center, Room 128 · Salve Regina University
cards.notes: Reserve a spot for the two-part campus training to learn support skills and earn the listed Mental Health First Aid certification.
cards.short_summary: A free two-session skills training offered through Salve campus offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve's Public Safety listing marks Mental Health First Aid Training as free and describes two four-hour sessions in Antone 128.
cards.access_notes: Registration availability is listed on the event page; the certification requires both four-hour class blocks.

cards.title: Support Lavender Honors recipients
cards.subtitle: Salve Regina University · Newport
cards.notes: Attend the Alliance ceremony to recognize LGBTQ+ and ally graduating students and join the campus community in celebrating award recipients.
cards.short_summary: A free, all-welcome recognition gathering hosted by Salve's Alliance.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve's Alliance lists the Lavender Honors Ceremony RSVP as free and says all are welcome to attend and support LGBTQ+ graduating students.
cards.access_notes: The ceremony is presented by the Alliance; the listing says all are welcome, while recognition is for graduating students.
